Your Guide to Chartering

New to yacht charters? We’ll guide you through everything, from choosing the right yacht to planning your perfect itinerary. Already experienced? Our FAQs cover all the essentials so you can focus on the journey.

First time charter Guide Read charter FAQs

How can we be of Service?

Why charter a yacht?

Because it’s the most personal way to travel. Wake up somewhere new each morning. Dine where the view shifts with the tide. Explore off-grid destinations no resort can reach. Chartering a yacht means freedom, comfort, and privacy on your own schedule. It’s luxury without limits, and every moment is yours to define.

How long is a yacht charter season?

Yachting has two main seasons: summer (May to October) in the Mediterranean and winter (November to April) in the Caribbean, peaking at Christmas and New Year. Booking in the shoulder seasons offers crowd avoidance, flexible rates, and a wider selection.

Read our charter guide

Where can I charter a yacht?

With access to a global fleet of yachts for charter all over the world, Velora offers diverse yachting destinations. In the summer, the Mediterranean is a top choice, while the Bahamas and Caribbean draw many clients during the winter months.

WHERE TO GO WHEN

How far can a yacht travel?

Most superyachts cross oceans with ease. Their range depends on design and purpose. Explorer yachts can sail thousands of miles, while fast sport models chase the sun between ports. Wherever you want to go, and however you want to get there, we’ll find a yacht that can take you there in style.

Explore Yacht Charter Destinations

How much does it cost to charter a yacht?

Charter rates are typically quoted by the week and prices vary depending on the model of the yacht, size, year built, and onboard amenities. Most yachts have higher rates during peak season (July, August, Christmas and New Year) with lower rates throughout the rest of the year.

Browse our yachts available for charter

How do I charter a yacht?

If you're a complete beginner when it comes to chartering, don't worry. Our team of experts will guide you through the entire process. From choosing the perfect yacht and negotiating the best rates to fine-tuning your exclusive itinerary, we've got you covered.

Speak to our team of specialists

What is included in a yacht charter?

Every charter is bespoke, but always includes a professional crew, world-class facilities, and meals prepared by your private chef. Water toys come standard; get your high speed thrills on tenders and seabobs or jump on a paddleboard to discover the coastline at your own pace. Everything else, from dive trips to starlit dinners, is tailored around how you want to live at sea.

How many guests can be on board a yacht charter?

Most luxury yachts welcome 8 to 12 guests, depending on layout and design. Some explorers and mega yachts host 20 or more. Every cabin feels like a private suite, and there’s always room to gather or slip away when you need to. Whether it’s a charter with family, friends, or both, we’ll find a yacht that fits your crew perfectly.
